description: React component for a modal dialog that allows adding a user to a channel in Mattermost. It includes channel search with suggestions, membership checks, and user addition functionality.

classes.name: AddUserToChannelModal
classes.description: React component class for the modal to add a user to a channel, managing state, user interactions, and channel suggestions.

methods.name: enableChannelProvider
methods.description: Enables the suggestion provider for channel search.

methods.name: focusTextbox
methods.description: Focuses the channel search textbox and places the caret at the end.

methods.name: onInputChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the search input field.

methods.name: onExited
methods.description: Callback after modal exit, calls parent handler.

methods.name: setSearchBoxRef
methods.description: Sets reference to the suggestion box component and focuses the textbox.

methods.name: didSelectChannel
methods.description: Handles selection of a channel from suggestions, checks membership.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to add user to selected channel.

methods.name: isUserMemberOfChannel
methods.description: Checks if the user is already a member of the specified channel.
